budgetScope: Per asset. Aggregate estimates sum separately loaded assets without cross-GLB sharing.
preservation: All non-image/accessor/IBM bufferView descriptors and bytes are immutable. Original image holes may be replaced/reused; image views and BIN length may change.

textures.estimate: RGBA8 or SRGB8_ALPHA8; mip estimate includes 4/3 chain. Renderer estimate counts each used texture-index/color-space variant; unique-image estimate deduplicates identical PNG hashes.
